name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI setup as cards or a tree and a map: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp), MCP servers and skills. Connect them by drawing a line, with preview and Undo; the map lights up while an agent works. Find models on Hugging Face as in LM Studio (what fits your GPU, what a name means), download or remove them; start agents here or in a terminal; install local LLMs. 8 languages.
